sloka: श्रुत्वा ऽतिकायस्य वचः सरोषं सगर्वितं संयति राजपुत्रः।स सञ्चुकोपातिबलो बृहच्छ्रीरुवाच वाक्यं च ततो महार्थम् ।। ६.७१.५७ ।।
transliteration: śrutvā 'tikāyasya vacaḥ saroṣaṁ sagarvitaṁ saṁyati rājaputraḥ।sa sañcukopātibalo bṛhacchrīruvāca vākyaṁ ca tato mahārtham ।। 6.71.57 ।।

translations.english: Prince Atikaya, having spoken as said before, fitted his bow in wrath. Hearing the proud statement of Atikaya, the highminded Lakshmana, endowed with strength, enraged, and spoke these words of great meaning.
